Details.title: Details
Details.description:
A JSON string for the résumé wizard, formatted like: {"title":"Résumé Parser","subtitle":"Upload a résumé, review the parsed work history, then save.","contactId":"003..."}

Rules: 'title' is the heading, 'subtitle' is helper text, and 'contactId' is the resolved Contact Id used to prefill the editable Contact picker. The wizard handles upload, parse, review/edit, and save on its own.
